root_cause.text: The mac80211 TTLM parsing function unconditionally reads the link map presence indicator byte even when the TTLM control flag indicates a default link map, causing an out-of-bounds read beyond the element length.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a condition `if (!(control & IEEE80211_TTLM_CONTROL_DEF_LINK_MAP))` before reading `link_map_presence`, indicating the old code always read that byte. The CVE description confirms that TTLM elements with a default mapping do not contain the link mapping presence indicator and mac80211 would read one byte beyond the end of the element.

candidates.rationale: Unconditionally reads the link map presence byte without checking if the TTLM control indicates a default link map, leading to out-of-bounds read.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally reads the link map presence indicator byte from the element buffer without first verifying that the TTLM control flag indicates a non-default link map. When the control flag indicates a default link map, the element does not contain this byte, leading to an out-of-bounds read beyond the element length.
